swap_risks: CAUTION INDUCTOR RETUNING: Typical inductor differs (TPS54231DR: 10 µH p.14 vs TPS54331DR: 6.8 µH p.16); check inductor Isat against peak switch current limit.

CAUTION CURRENT RATING BASIS: TPS54231DR specifies 2000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1) vs TPS54331DR 3000 mA (continuous Iout, p.1). Verify continuous load current and peak inductor saturation margin (Isat >= Iout + ΔIL/2).
engineering_verdict: TPS54231DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) and TPS54331DR (Texas Instruments, SOIC-8) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because recommended inductor value differs >20%; current rating or switch-limit basis differs. Power-stage deltas: buck (non-sync) vs buck (non-sync), switching frequency 570 kHz (p.6) vs 570 kHz (p.6) (1x ratio), typical inductor 10 µH (p.14) vs 6.8 µH (p.16), feedback Vref 0.8 V (p.6) vs 0.8 V (p.5), and package θJA 116.3 vs 116.3 °C/W. Primary bench gotchas to watch: TPS54231DR "EN Pin Abs Max Is Strictly 6.0 V — NEVER Tie Directly to 12 V or 24 V VIN" (p.5) and TPS54331DR "Non-Synchronous Architecture Requires External Schottky Catch Diode & External COMP Network" (p.1). BOM decision: Choose TPS54231DR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOIC-8 (D) qualification and -40..150 °C grade; choose TPS54331DR when higher load current capacity (3000 mA) is required. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.4 vs TOP_VIEW p.3) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
